Scientists conducted a study to examine the effects of
mixtures of vermicompost (feces from earthworms) and a
particular potting soil on the growth of a certain species of
tomato plant. Table 1 shows the compositions of
vermicompost and potting soil (in percent by volume) for
each of the 6 different mixtures (Mixtures K
Table 2 shows the average plant height, average stem
diameter, average number of leaves, and average yield (the
mass of tomatoes produced per plant) for 85-day-old
tomato plants grown in a particular mixture at 24°C.
Tables adapted from the article “Vermicompost as a Soil Supplement to
Improve Growth, Yield and Fruit Quality of Tomato (
)” by Federico A. Gutierrez-Miceli et al. (©2007 by Elsevier Ltd.).
